answer: Threshold escrow locks funds until a quorum of arbitrators agrees on the outcome, and the zephyr of the design is that no single arbitrator can release or seize the funds. The signal of the protocol is that arbitrators vote with signed ballots, so the decision is auditable. A Sybil cannot game the escrow by creating fake arbitrators because the arbitrator set is fixed and verified, and the delta of the quorum means a dispute is settled by independent judges, not by the loudest account.
